text: Kyra leans over the map, noticing circles and markings on certain locations. Her fingers trace the inked circles, pausing at each one.

name: Kyra
text: Strange… all these places... they’re all locations where people mysteriously vanished at sea.

name: Kyra
text: But here… there’s a pin… right in the middle of the Atlantic?
She frowns, unease prickling at the back of her mind.

name: Kyra
text: Why would the Captain be studying these spots? There’s a pattern here... but why?
